name: Kazuha
source:
Looking for her missing brother Shiki, Kazuha begins to play the video game “Arcadia,” and becomes trapped in the game world. She is loyal and obedient, but strong enough to voice her opinions when challenged.

After an unexpected turn of events force her to become the “Almighty,” both Angels and Demons start to see her as a possession to be acquired. She works hard to progress through their adventure, and assists her allies as a Minstrel.

[From the [url=http://aksysgames.com/pcube/]official site[/url]]
